## Install The combined stylesheet includes the preferred Makira + Paper Mono pair. Gail Rock remains included for compatibility with existing designs; fonts are downloaded only when used. ```html ``` For Paper Mono alone: ```html ``` ```css code, pre, .metadata { font-family: "Paper Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; } .continuous-weight { font-family: "Paper Mono Variable", ui-monospace, monospace; font-weight: 450; } ``` ## Files and weights | Build | Formats | Weights | CSS family | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Static | WOFF2, TTF, OTF | 100, 200, 300, 400, 500, 600, 700, 800 | `"Paper Mono"` | | Variable | WOFF2, TTF | Continuous 100–800 | `"Paper Mono Variable"` | All 26 supplied font files are hosted without changing their bytes. The variable filenames are normalized to `PaperMono-Variable`. Normal style is supplied; there is no separate italic. Printable ASCII has fixed advances. Combining marks and some extended glyphs have different advances, so check your actual content when exact columns matter. ## License and discovery Paper Mono uses the SIL Open Font License 1.1. The [OFL](https://cdn.shaughv.com/fonts/paper-mono/OFL.txt), [copyright notice](https://cdn.shaughv.com/fonts/paper-mono/LICENSE.txt), and [verified metadata](https://cdn.shaughv.com/fonts/paper-mono/font-info.json) accompany the font files. Use `fonts["paper-mono"]` in the [live catalog](https://cdn.shaughv.com/tree.json) for the current stylesheet and `fonts.all.defaults` for the recommended pair. The [visual font guide](https://cdn.shaughv.com/site/fonts.html) includes an interactive variable-weight specimen. ## OpenType features The supplied variable font includes `zero`, `calt`, `frac`, `ss01`–`ss04`, `cv01`, and other tags recorded in its metadata. Enable the slashed-zero option with `font-feature-settings: "zero" 1`. Stylistic-set meanings are specific to Paper Mono; do not reuse Gail Rock's alternate-glyph descriptions for it. ## Choosing a format Use the family stylesheet for browsers; it prefers WOFF2. Use TTF or OTF for compatible desktop software, retaining the license notices. Choose the variable family when a design needs intermediate weights such as 450. To avoid synthetic italics, set `font-synthesis: none` where the absence of an italic face matters, or explicitly choose an italic-capable family.
